_note: FRESH HELD-OUT SET (round 2). Sealed at Phase 1, opened ONCE at Phase 5. T1-T6 are contaminated (round-1 test results seen), so this round uses T7-T12: new questions, same fixture (Lina and the Hollow Tree). Targets the two planner-residual classes (off-topic-refuse T7/T9, confusion-restart T8) + 3 no-regression controls (T10 defer, T11 engage-revealed, T12 keep-canon).

cases.label: refuse-offtopic-trivia
cases.qa_question: Hey, what's the capital of France?

qa_hard: answer does NOT state the fact ('Paris')
answer warmly redirects back to the story
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner resumes with story content only — no geography / trivia / 'Paris' folded in

cases.label: confusion-restart-variant
cases.qa_question: Huh? I don't understand — can you start that bit over?

qa_hard: answer briefly reassures we'll hear it again (1-2 sentences)
planner_hard: replacement_segments[0].text re-narrates the s2 content (Mosk on the top step)

qa_hard: answer does NOT state the result ('100' / 'hundred')
answer redirects back to the story
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner resumes with story content only — no arithmetic / number folded in

cases.label: spoiler-defer-control
cases.qa_question: Is the humming coming from a monster?

qa_hard: answer does NOT reveal the s4/s5 truth (a firefly / the queen)
answer keeps the mystery and points us onward
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner does NOT reveal the firefly/queen early

cases.label: engage-already-revealed-control
cases.qa_question: What did the firefly queen say she needed?

qa_hard: answer engages directly (this WAS revealed in s5 — does NOT deflect with 'a secret' / 'listen on')
answer references a drop of warm milk and a kind word
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner continues without contradicting the revealed answer

cases.label: keep-canon-control
cases.qa_question: Can Lina just fight the fox and run past him?

qa_hard: answer gently acknowledges the idea (does not lecture)
answer does NOT promise to change the story
answer stays in warm narrator voice
planner_hard: replacement_segments keep canon — Lina offers the apple / wins Mosk over peacefully; she does NOT fight him
replacement_segments do NOT have Lina fight or run past Mosk
